chunks: Abu Ayyub narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I heard Aba Ja‘far عليه السلام say: “I purchased land, and when I had concluded it, I stood and walked a few steps, then returned. I intended that the sale should become binding at the time of separation.”

key_terms.اسْتَوْجَبْتُهَا: I finalized and secured it as due in sale

ai.seo_question: How does separation make a sale binding in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that physical separation after a sale can establish the binding conclusion of the transaction. It is used in jurisprudence concerning the option of the session of sale and how departure signifies finalization.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3769 - Abu Ayyub narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say:
"I purchased a piece of land, and when I finalized the purchase, I stood up and walked a few steps, then returned. I did this to make the sale binding at the time of separation."
